content.Purpose: Guideline on the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease.

Findings.Study: Estruch R, Ros E, Salas-Salvadó J, et al.
Findings.Conclusion: Mediterranean diet with extra-virgin olive oil or nuts reduced all-cause mortality.

Findings.Study: Chiuve SE, Cook NR, et al.
Findings.Conclusion: Higher diet quality associated with reduced mortality in women.

Findings.Study: Song M, Fung TT, Hu FB, et al.
Findings.Conclusion: Lower animal and higher plant protein intake associated with reduced mortality.
Optimal dose for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease varies.

Findings.Study: Smith NT, Sanderson S, et al.
Findings.Conclusion: Cycling decreases cardiovascular and overall mortality risks.
